checks.single_mixture: All group NLLs match the frozen scoring; every partition reconstructs all metrics.
checks.region_calibrated_mixture: All group NLLs match the frozen scoring; every partition reconstructs all metrics.

definitions.aggregation: Mean sites within query, equal queries within component/region, panel-weighted queries for all_panels; then equal components and seeds.
definitions.contributions: A subset keeps its original denominator; absent sites contribute zero. Partition masses sum to 1 and metric contributions sum to the overall metric.
definitions.conditional_delta: Mean additive contribution divided by mean weighted mass; not an equal average over nonempty components.
definitions.counts: Target-site observations across queries and three seeds, not unique residues or independent observations.
definitions.jensen: mixture_minus_esm = alpha*(task_nll-esm_nll) - ((1-alpha)*esm_nll+alpha*task_nll-mixture_nll), evaluated at each site before aggregation.
definitions.rank: One-based rank; exact ties broken by stored AA order, also used for top1.
definitions.uncertainty: 2000 conditional component bootstrap samples of additive contributions after seed averaging; no refitting or site bootstrap.
definitions.oracle: Choose lower component-mean single-head NLL after averaging seeds; descriptive hindsight reference, not a deployable model.
definitions.limits: Post hoc decomposition, overlapping mask contexts, historically evaluated held-out set. Neither independent confirmation nor causal biological information attribution. Panel parameters apply to the entire query, not residue-specific domain routing.
